description:
NinjaTrader 8 is running on the Windows desktop with real daily OHLCV data available for AAPL. 

A technical analyst needs a Point & Figure chart to identify significant support/resistance levels without the noise of time-based charts.

Your task:
1. Open a new chart for 'AAPL'.
2. Configure the chart Data Series to use the 'Point & Figure' bar type (instead of Minute/Day).
3. Set the Point & Figure parameters: Box size = 2, Reversal = 3.
4. Add a Simple Moving Average (SMA) indicator to the chart with a Period of 20.
5. Save the workspace via the Control Center (File > Save Workspace) to ensure your changes are persisted.

Login credentials (if needed): Docker / GymAnything123!
